ios.desc:
Send, open and edit Office files from your mobile with the full power of Microsoft’s word-processing tools. Whether you're a writer, freelancer, student or project manager, Word moves with you.

Enhance your writing with Copilot in Word when signed in with your Microsoft 365 subscription.* Draft, edit, collaborate, and share with confidence – anytime, anywhere.

Create impactful blogs, proposals, CVs, branding materials and more. Customise every document with rich formatting options and professionally designed templates.

Create Documents
•  Kick-start projects with templates for letters, CVs, scripts, proposals, invoices and more 
•  Use robust formatting and layout tools to express ideas clearly 
•  Maintain a polished look across all your devices
Read, Write and Edit Anywhere
•  Edit long documents, letters and scripts on your device with familiar writing tools 
•  Open attachments with the built in viewer 
•  Convert PDFs to Word for quick editing
Collaborate and Share
•  Leave comments directly next to relevant text 
•  Work with others in real time and track layout or formatting changes 
•  Use version history to view and restore previous drafts
Simplified Sharing
•  Invite others to edit or view in just a few taps 
•  Manage permissions and see who’s active in the document 
•  Copy formatted content into emails or attach your files instantly
AI Assistance with Copilot*
•  Draft CVs, polish proposals and organise ideas in seconds 
•  Summarise, refine and format content instantly 
•  Get intelligent suggestions to make your writing clear and compelling
*Unlock the full Microsoft 365 experience with a qualifying subscription on phone, tablet, PC or Mac.

Microsoft 365 subscriptions purchased in app will be charged to your App Store account and automatically renew unless auto renew is turned off 24 hours before the billing period ends. Manage your subscription in your App Store account settings. Subscriptions cannot be cancelled during the active period.

This app may be provided by Microsoft or a third party publisher and is subject to its own privacy statement and terms. Data may be transferred to, stored and processed in the United States or other regions where Microsoft or its affiliates operate.

EULA: http://aka.ms/eula

Maybe it's just the bait-and-switch tone of the commercials that throws me off. It does seem like Office would run on any iPad [0], and they could just be referring to the pencil. However, even the description there [0] is kind of weirdly worded to me. I just don't know enough about Apple devices I guess.

> * Word is ready for iPad Pro and looks amazing on the 12.9-inch screen. Read Word documents on iPad Pro for free. To create and edit docs, you need a qualifying Office 365 subscription. Try it for free for 30 days. * 
The real Microsoft Word app designed for iPad, iPhone and iPod touch.
